units.source_text: 可是大公主眼眶含泪，指了指洞穴说：“可是，

en.t: But the eldest princess had tears in her eyes, pointed toward the cave, and said, "But,

units.source_text: 把我抓到这里的食蜃人刚喝醉了正在酣睡，

en.t: the mirage-eater who captured me and brought me here has just gotten drunk and is sleeping soundly,

units.source_text: 等会儿他醒过来，一定会追上咱们，

en.t: when he wakes up in a little while, he will surely catch up with us,
and then all of us will die."
